answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in a juniper registry and needs eight counterparties per epoch. Puppets cannot wander far: they reuse the same few partners, so diversity collapses and audits burn bonds below threshold. Partners must span four grove clusters. Eight partners cost 15 each, so 1,000 fakes pay 120,000 for a 40,000 pool, a sure 80,000 loss. Rented partners burn with the puppet. One honest agent pays 120 once and keeps its share.
